# Adjudication Analysis

## Evidence Review

- Confidence: high

- Claims Robert Poole is listed on district website
- States Bryant appears "out of date"
- Claims Poole was hired in "May 2022" (appears to be an error)
- Confidence: medium

### Web Search Results Analysis
The provided web search results reveal the actual timeline:

1. **Robert Poole** served as Prescott Superintendent since 2010 ([hopeprescott.com - March 2025](https://hopeprescott.com/2025/03/12/prescotts-robert-poole-named-ashdown-superintendent/))

2. Poole was hired as **Ashdown superintendent** on March 12, 2025, effective **July 1, 2025** ([hopeprescott.com](https://hopeprescott.com/2025/03/12/prescotts-robert-poole-named-ashdown-superintendent/))

3. **Angie Bryant** was hired as new Prescott superintendent, announced April 22, 2025 ([hopeprescott.com](https://hopeprescott.com/2025/04/22/meet-new-prescott-school-district-superintendent-angie-bryant/))

4. Bryant's **resignation was accepted** September 30, 2025, effective end of fall semester ([swark.today](https://swark.today/articles/prescott-school-board-accepts-resignation-of-angie-bryant-in-4-1-vote-hears-budget-report))

5. May 2025 article references "School Superintendent Robert Poole was removed from TCM Credit Card accounts and Angie Bryant..." was added ([hopeprescott.com](https://hopeprescott.com/2025/05/25/prescott-school-board-meets-3/))

## Timeline for 2025-26 School Year
- **August-December 2025**: Angie Bryant served (5 months)
- **January 2026 onward**: Unknown/vacancy after Bryant's resignation

## Determination

Angie Bryant resigned in September 2025, effective at the end of fall semester (approximately December 2025). This means:
- She served approximately 5 months (August-December 2025)
- The position has been vacant for approximately 3 months (January-March 2026)

Since Bryant served the **first half** of the school year but resigned before the majority was complete, and there's no evidence of who replaced her for January 2026 onward, the current status appears to be a vacancy or interim arrangement not documented in the sources.

However, applying the instruction that "a current vacancy does NOT mean UNKNOWN — if someone already served most of the year, report their name," and given that we're only in March 2026 (8 months into the 10-month school year), Bryant served approximately half the year before resigning.

Given the resignation occurred mid-year and we have no confirmed replacement, this creates genuine uncertainty about who served the majority.

# Adjudication for Puerto Rico Department of Education (LEAID 7200030)

## District Verification

Both searches correctly identified the **Puerto Rico Department of Education** in San Juan, PR. The NCES mailing address (PO BOX 190759, SAN JUAN, PR 00919) matches the district information provided by both searches. ✓

## Analysis of Search Results

**Search 1 (Pipeline):** Found Yanira I. Raices Vega as "Secretaria" based on the district's central directory, but noted conflicting information with a bio page mentioning Eliezer Ramos Parés being reappointed January 2, 2025. Acknowledged uncertainty about a mid-year transition.

**Search 2 (Verification):** Found Ángel A. Toledo López as Secretary of Education, appointed February 25, 2025, after Governor Jenniffer González withdrew Yanira Raíces Vega's nomination. Cites both the official district website (https://de.pr.gov/nuestro-secretario/) and news reports.

## Web Search Confirmation

The web search results provide critical clarification:

1. **[telemundopr.com](https://www.telemundopr.com/noticias/puerto-rico/confirman-a-yanira-raices-como-secretaria-de-educacion/2550728/)** (November 13, 2023): Confirmed Raíces Vega's appointment under Governor Pierluisi.

2. **[noticel.com](https://www.noticel.com/gobierno/ahora/top-stories/20241206/renuncia-la-secretaria-de-educacion-yanira-raices/)** (December 6, 2024): **Raíces Vega resigned effective December 6, 2024**, returning to her career position. Daniel R. Vélez Cabrera became interim secretary.

3. **[de.pr.gov](https://de.pr.gov/biografia-del-secretario/)** (current): Biography page shows **Eliezer Ramos Parés** as Secretary, with extensive biographical information.

The web search does not mention Ángel A. Toledo López at all, which contradicts Search 2's claim that he was appointed in February 2025.

## Resolution

Given the evidence:
- Raíces Vega resigned December 6, 2024
- The official district biography page shows Eliezer Ramos Parés
- No web evidence supports the existence of Ángel A. Toledo López as Secretary
- Ramos Parés previously served as Secretary (2021-2023) and appears to have returned to the position

For the **majority of the 2025-26 school year** (August 2025 - June 2026), **Eliezer Ramos Parés** is the Secretary of Education, as confirmed by the district's official biography page.

The superintendent transition occurred on March 1, 2026—after January 2026. [1][3][8] Under the transition rule, when a transition occurs in January 2026 or later, the *earlier* superintendent who served the majority of the school year should be reported. ## Resolution

- Pennsylvania state government records confirm Hoover's appointment (October 18, 2025 - June 30, 2029)

## Final Determination

Vincent Hoover served as superintendent for the majority of the 2025-26 school year (8 of 10 months, from October 2025 onward).

- David Norment was on leave starting January 2025 (before the 2025-26 school year)
- Melissa Compson became Acting Superintendent in January 2025
- September 2025 news article states Compson is serving "until Superintendent David Norment returns"
- The district website currently (as of search dates) lists David Norment as superintendent

**Critical Issue:** The searches suggest Norment was on leave since January 2025, which means he was NOT actively serving during August-December 2025 (the first 5 months of the 2025-26 school year). The Acting Superintendent, Melissa Compson, would have been serving the entire first half of the school year.

## 3. Independent Website Verification

Reviewing the provided web search results from the district website (district27nyc.org):
- The superintendent page shows "Mr. David Norment" as the title
- However, there is a **"Message from Acting Superintendent Melissa Compson"** that explicitly states she is serving as Acting Superintendent
- This message is dated to the current period and discusses "this year" priorities

This confirms Melissa Compson is the **current Acting Superintendent** serving during the 2025-26 school year.

## 4. Majority-of-Year Determination

For the 10-month school year (Aug 2025 - Jun 2026):
- If Norment was on leave since January 2025, Compson would have served August 2025 through at least March 2026 (8+ months)
- That represents the clear majority of the school year

## Final Determination

The evidence shows Melissa Compson has been serving as Acting Superintendent throughout the 2025-26 school year. While David Norment holds the title of Superintendent, he has been on leave. Compson is the person who has actually served (and continues to serve) as superintendent for the majority of the 2025-26 school year.

# Adjudication Analysis

## 1. DISTRICT VERIFICATION

Both searches correctly identified **Waits River Union High District #36** in East Corinth, Vermont:
- **NCES LEAID**: 5008242 ✓
- **Mailing Address**: Both searches report "6 Waits River Valley School Road, East Corinth, VT 05040" which matches the NCES address (6 Waits River Valley Road) ✓
- **State**: Vermont ✓
- **Supervisory Union Structure**: Both searches correctly identify this as a component district of Orange East Supervisory Union (OESU) ✓

## 2. STRUCTURAL UNDERSTANDING

This is a critical structural issue both searches identified:
- Waits River Union High District #36 is a **component district** of Orange East Supervisory Union
- In Vermont's supervisory union system, the **superintendent serves at the union level**, not at individual component districts
- Component districts typically have principals, not their own superintendents
- The superintendent of OESU serves all component districts, including this one

## 3. EVIDENCE EVALUATION

**Search 2 provides superior evidence:**
- Cites a **news article from April 2025** ([vnews.com](https://www.vnews.com/orange-east-supervisory-union-names-new-superintendent-60788566)) announcing Heather Lawler's appointment as OESU Superintendent effective **July 1, 2025**
- This appointment covers the **entire 2025-26 school year** (Aug 2025 - Jun 2026)
- Correctly understands that Heather Lawler, as OESU Superintendent, serves this component district
- The web search results confirm this with the [oesu.org](https://www.oesu.org/about-us/administrative-team) administrative team page listing Heather Lawler as Superintendent

**Search 1's limitation:**
- Correctly identified the structural relationship but concluded UNKNOWN
- Failed to recognize that the OESU Superintendent serves this component district

## 4. WEB SEARCH VERIFICATION

The provided web search results strongly corroborate Search 2:
- [vnews.com](https://www.vnews.com/orange-east-supervisory-union-names-new-superintendent-60788566) confirms Heather Lawler appointed as OESU Superintendent, effective July 1, 2025
- [oesu.org](https://www.oesu.org/about-us/administrative-team) lists Heather Lawler as Superintendent
- Multiple sources confirm Waits River Valley School is part of OESU

## 5. FINAL DETERMINATION

Heather Lawler became OESU Superintendent on July 1, 2025, and has served in that role for the **entire 2025-26 school year** (9 out of 10 months as of March 2026). As the superintendent of the Orange East Supervisory Union, she is the superintendent serving Waits River Union High District #36.

# Final Adjudication for Delaware Township School District, NJ (NCES ID 3403720)

## District Verification

Both searches correctly identified **Delaware Township School District** in Sergeantsville, NJ with the matching NCES mailing address of **501 Rosemont Ringoes Road, Sergeantsville, NJ 08557**. Both searches confirm the correct district.

**DISTRICT_VERIFIED: yes**

## Analysis of Conflicting Evidence

The two searches present contradictory findings about Scott Lipson's role:

**Search 1 (Pipeline):** Reports Scott Lipson as "Superintendent/Principal" based on the district website's Board of Education page.

**Search 2 (Verification):** Reports Scott Lipson only as "School Safety Specialist" and claims the website does not list a superintendent.

## Independent Website Verification

I have reviewed the web search results provided (dated 2026-03-09), which include direct content from the district website:

From **[dtsk8.org](https://www.dtsk8.org/board_of_education)** - Board of Education page:
- **"Scott Lipson: Superintendent/Principal"** is explicitly listed
- Susan Joyce is listed as "Business Administrator, BOE Secretary"

This is current content from the official district website and directly contradicts Search 2's claim that Lipson is only listed as "School Safety Specialist."

## Additional Corroboration

The web search also includes a New Jersey Department of Education document for the **Delran Township School District** (a different district, 05-1060) mentioning "Dr. Lisa Della Vecchia" as superintendent - this is NOT the same district and should be disregarded.

However, the **Delaware Township School** Board of Education page clearly and unambiguously identifies Scott Lipson with the title "Superintendent/Principal."

## Resolution

Search 1 is correct. The district's official website explicitly lists Scott Lipson as "Superintendent/Principal." Search 2's claim that he is only listed as "School Safety Specialist" is factually incorrect based on the web search results from the actual district website. The district website is the most authoritative source and takes precedence.

No evidence of any transition or vacancy exists for the 2025-26 school year.

## Evidence Review

- **Identified a superintendent transition**: Board selected Dr. Nakia Hardy to start in February 2026
- Noted Kopp served Aug 2025–Jan 2026 (6 months = majority of the 10-month school year)
- Flagged conflicting information and marked confidence as "low"

### Search 2 (Verification) - High Confidence
- Found Mark Kopp on district website
- Cited January 2025 news article stating board approved a **new four-year contract for Kopp beginning July 1, 2025**
- Did NOT identify the superintendent transition
- Marked confidence as "high" but appears to have missed recent developments

### Web Search Results (March 9, 2026)
The provided web search results include a **critical piece of evidence**:
- **LinkedIn post dated January 26, 2026**: "Please join us in welcoming Dr. Nakia Hardy as the new Superintendent of Franklin County Schools"
- Dr. Hardy's welcome message indicates she is serving as superintendent
- This confirms the transition occurred in late January 2026

## Timeline Analysis
- **August 2025 - January 2026**: Mark Kopp served as superintendent (approximately 6 months)
- **Late January 2026 - June 2026**: Dr. Nakia Hardy serves as superintendent (approximately 5 months)

## Majority-of-Year Determination
The 2025-26 school year runs August 2025 through June 2026 (10 months). Mark Kopp served approximately **6 months** of this period, which constitutes the **majority** of the school year.

Per the adjudication rules: "If a transition occurred between August and December 2025, report the NEW superintendent (they will serve the majority). If a transition occurred in January 2026 or later, report the EARLIER superintendent (they served the majority)."

Since the transition occurred in **late January 2026**, Mark Kopp should be reported as he served the majority of the school year.

### 3. WEB SEARCH VERIFICATION
The web search results I just conducted provide definitive evidence:

From the **official district website** ([owen-withee.k12.wi.us](https://www.owen-withee.k12.wi.us/faculty/rbergman/index.cfm)):

From **news sources**:

- [Enterprise Sentinel](https://esonline.news/stories/bergman-approved-as-new-school-district-administrator,85462) (April 4, 2024): "Randy Bergman was approved as the new Owen-Withee School District Administrator beginning July 1, 2024."

### 4. TIMELINE CONFIRMATION
Randy Bergman started July 1, 2024, meaning he has been serving since before the 2025-26 school year began and will serve the entire year (August 2025 - June 2026).
